description: Reviewed cardiacFoam allowlist for the approximate C++ dictionary-key scanner. Audited 2026-08-11 by three independent passes over the C++. Findings: (1) the 10 remaining stale_paths are scanner BLIND SPOTS, not catalog bugs -- the regex cannot follow dimensioned<T>(name, dict) constructors, spec.dictionaryEntry struct indirection, or dictionaries passed into upstream OpenFOAM (ODESolver::New reads solver/absTol/relTol/maxSteps flat from the coeffs dict, exactly as catalogued); (2) 'Vm' and 'Iion' are confirmed FALSE POSITIVES -- they are field names in string comparisons, IOobject names, and in one case a lookupOrDefault default VALUE, never dictionary keys. They stay waived only because the scanner still emits them; fixing the scanner is the real remedy; (3) 'TaScale', 'gamma' and 'initializeFields' are real C++ keys belonging to electroMechanicalProperties / the electromechanics verifier, deliberately out of scope for this electroProperties catalog. They were removed from the catalog because they were advertised at a path nothing reads. (4) 'global' is an ionicConstantOverrides scope now covered by the <scope> placeholder in the catalog rather than a literal path segment; the scanner cannot expand placeholders, so it reports the scope names as unmatched subdicts. (5) 'points', 'rootNode', 'pvjNodes', 'pvjLocations' and 'pvjResistances' are real dictionary::lookup/get/found reads (conductionGraph.H, conductionSystemDomain.C), but from constant/<graphFile> (e.g. constant/purkinjeGraph), a separate dict file this electroProperties catalog does not address -- structurally the same situation as electroMechanicalProperties. Deliberately left uncatalogued (not backlog): driverFOAM never constructs or mutates a graph file's contents anywhere in its Python code (checked -- no write site exists), it only ever references one by name via the already-catalogued graphFile key, generated separately by tools such as generatePurkinjeTree. The catalog documents keys subject to programmatic override; nothing here is ever overridden by driverFOAM, so there is no gap to close. (6) 'outputFile' and 'outputSuffix' were removed 2026-08-16 after commit b886204c deleted their only C++ reads (manufacturedFDABidomainVerifier, manufacturedFDABathBidomainVerifier, ionicModelIO) as part of the outputFile/outputSuffix override escape-hatch removal; the scanner now correctly reports zero absent_keys drift for these names.
